query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id, kind, subject) *
      FROM unnest($1::bigint[], $2::text[], $3::text[], $4::timestamptz[], $5::text[])
           AS i(session_id, kind, subject, since, message)
     ORDER BY session_id, kind, subject
), ins AS (
    INSERT INTO agents.work_item_attention (session_id, kind, subject, since, message)
    SELECT session_id, kind, subject, since, message FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (session_id, kind, subject) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id, session_id, kind, subject, delivery_attempts,
              last_delivery_attempt_at, disposition
)
SELECT ins.session_id AS "session_id!", ins.kind AS "kind!", ins.subject AS "subject!",
       ins.id AS "id!", true AS "inserted!", false AS "delivered!",
       ins.delivery_attempts AS "delivery_attempts!",
       ins.last_delivery_attempt_at AS "last_delivery_attempt_at?",
       ins.disposition AS "disposition!"
  FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT a.session_id, a.kind, a.subject, a.id, false,
       a.delivered_message_uuid IS NOT NULL, a.delivery_attempts,
       a.last_delivery_attempt_at, a.disposition
  FROM input i
  JOIN agents.work_item_attention a
    ON a.session_id = i.session_id AND a.kind = i.kind AND a.subject = i.subject
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM ins
            WHERE ins.session_id = i.session_id
              AND ins.kind = i.kind
              AND ins.subject = i.subject
       )
